title: Looks nice, nice colors.
text: Looks nice, nice colors.. It looks like real wood, but it is not.  It's manufactured wood.  The colors are nice and go well with my decor.  There is glass in the frame, not plastic as some are.

product_metadata.title: DII Distressed Wooden Picture Frame Collection Rustic Farmhouse Inspired, 8x10, Blush
features: RUSTIC FARMHOUSE LOOK: Complete your décor with this vintage wood composite picture frame. Perfect for storing memories.
DURABLE & ATTRACTIVE: Made of top rated wood composite and glass this frame is long lasting. No acrylic that can scratch or yellow overtime.

CREATE THE PERFECT LOOK FOR YOUR MEMORIES: Mix and match the various sizes, colors and finishes to create the perfect look in your home or at a party. These frames can be displayed together or alone to get the perfect look for your photo memories.
EASILY MOUNTED OR DISPLAYED: Mounting hardware included to hang on wall. Also includes easel style backing to use on desk or counter top.
PROTECTIVE PACKAGING: Wrapped to ensure safe delivery to your home. Packaging protects frame and glass.
description: DII offers full collections of trend based designs, bringing you fresh, innovative lines of quality home products for every season. Let DII products become a valuable part of your life.
